sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Laser Micro-Machining of Bioresorbable Vascular Polymer Stents

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law, French Civil Law and Customary Law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No active standalone bilateral investment treaty currently in force with major capital-exporting jurisdictions
Vanuatu is a WTO Member (2012 accession commitments apply)
International tax transparency and exchange-of-information arrangements concluded under the OECD TIEA framework

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (as amended, including beneficial ownership amendments); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 25 of 2021; Financial Intelligence Unit Act No. 26 of 2021 (as applicable); VFSC beneficial ownership filing directives; FIU consolidated AML/CFT Regulations and Guidance.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each shareholder, director, and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority of the person or a notary public licensed in the person's jurisdiction of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization by the Republic of Vanuatu diplomatic/consular authority; Hague Apostille is not applicable because Vanuatu is not a Contracting Party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-wealth confirmation for each material UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Financial institution where the UBO maintains the account, signed by the branch manager or compliance officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and consular legalization where required by the originating jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or Certificate of Good Standing for any corporate shareholder above the 25% ownership threshold
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization or apostille depending on the exporting state's treaty status; for Vanuatu filing, a certified English translation is required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, and authorized signatories against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the Vanuatu FIU/VFSC domestic denial and warning lists. Politically Exposed Persons (PEP), their family members, and close associates are subject to enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth verification, and senior-management approval before incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies Registry e-Registry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in English or French using the standard Roman alphabet. Bislama-only names are not accepted. Names may contain letters A–Z, Arabic numerals, hyphens, and commonly accepted punctuation; diacritical marks not forming part of Latin script are discouraged and subject to VFSC transliteration review.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: No automatic extension is available; a new name reservation application may be filed after expiry. Upon rejection, the applicant must file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 21 days of the rejection notice, stating the distinctiveness and permissibility of the proposed name. If the Registrar affirms the rejection, the applicant may apply to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu for judicial review within 14 days of the affirmation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual-office-only arrangements are not permissible. A licensed registered agent and a physical registered office in Vanuatu are mandatory for an International Company; the registered agent must maintain physical custody of the statutory registers and corporate records.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for a purely non-resident intermediary trading entity, estimated at 5–8% per annum, but materially higher if sanctions alerts, PEP flags, medical-device regulatory inquiries, or FIU intelligence triggers are present.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name clearance and availability search fee
International Company incorporation and registration filing fee
Licensed registered agent annual fee incorporating registered office and statutory record custody
UBO register setup, beneficial ownership filing, and statutory record preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent in coordination with VFSC filing office

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, consular legalization, and courier handling of passport copies and corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notaries, courier services, and Vanuatu consular authorities

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, and domestic sanctions screening setup per director, shareholder, and UBO
Client due diligence file review, source-of-wealth analysis, and AML/CFT procedures sign-off
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External legal counsel or compliance officer

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222], ss. 3, 8–12 (incorporation and constitution), s. 14 (registered office), s. 15 (registered agent), ss. 47–53 (first directors and officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association accompanied by Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation) and registered agent's consent; Certificate of Incorporation issued upon approval
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an International Company; subscribers may set authorised capital at their discretion, and the issue price is determined in the Articles; no escrow account is required by law, but the VFSC may request a bank reference confirming the source of initial share subscription funds
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) that the subscriber shares set forth in the Articles of Association be allotted to the named subscribers at par, and the Directors be directed to record such allotment in the Register of Members; (2) that the registered office of the Company be fixed at the registered agent's office in Port Vila, Vanuatu; (3) that the directors named in the Articles be confirmed in office and the Chairman be authorised to open corporate bank accounts and execute banking mandates; (4) that the Corporate Secretary be appointed; and (5) that the Chairman be authorised to file all regulatory and industrial licence applications and execute documents on behalf of the Company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry – Name Reservation Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request online or through the registered agent, specifying the proposed corporate name, intended business purpose, and whether the company will be restricted from carrying on business with Vanuatu residents. Pay the fee and receive a name reservation certificate.
required_dossiers: Completed name reservation form (Form IC-0)
Copy of proposed Memorandum and Articles cover page
Registered agent's instruction letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or flagged as confusingly similar, the applicant may submit a new name together with a written explanation of the distinction; VFSC normally adjudicates within 2 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-approved Registered Agent and Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed registered agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association. Ensure the object clause covers medical device manufacturing, stent micro-machining, and related trade activities. Have subscribers execute the documents before a notary public; notarize the subscribers' passport copies and proof of residential address.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Notarized passport copies of each subscriber
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, not older than 3 months)
Consent of proposed directors to act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary requires confirmatory evidence, the subscriber must supply a certified copy of identification and a bank reference; re-notarization may be completed within 1 working day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation) along with the executed and notarized Memorandum and Articles, registered agent consent, and payment of the statutory filing fee. The application must specify the registered agent details and confirm the scope of lawful business (ISIC 3250 medical device manufacturing).
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 duly signed by registered agent
Memorandum and Articles of Association (executed and notarized)
Registered agent's consent (Form IC-2)
Declaration of compliance signed by the subscriber
Government fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a query or notice of non-compliance, the registered agent has 14 days to file a response with corrected documents. A curing step may entail amending the Articles and filing a supplementary declaration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Register Initiation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon application approval, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the registration number and date. The registered agent then obtains the certificate and initiates the statutory registers: register of members, register of directors and secretaries, register of charges, and minute book.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (issued)
VFSC generated company extract
Register of members (to be completed by registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical errors, notify VFSC within 5 working days and file Form IC-7 for amendment; VFSC will issue an amended certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office and Registered Agent Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry – Registered Agent Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-3 (Notice of Registered Office) with the VFSC, providing the physical address of the registered agent's office in Vanuatu, which will serve as the registered office of the Company. Obtain the registered agent's written acknowledgment.
required_dossiers: Form IC-3
Registered agent's consent to act as registered office
Registered agent's certificate certifying office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the address is invalid or the agent terminates, the Company must appoint a new licensed agent and file Form IC-3 again within 14 days to avoid administrative strike-off.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of First Directors and Corporate Secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The subscriber passes a written resolution appointing the first directors and secretary. File the declaration of first directors (Form IC-6) with the VFSC, attaching signed consents. Ensure at least one director is an individual, unless the Company has obtained a special waiver; corporate secretaries are permitted.
required_dossiers: Form IC-6 (Declaration of First Directors and Secretary)
Director consent and personal identification
Secretary consent
Minutes of the subscriber resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director's consent is invalid or missing, resubmit the corrected declaration within 7 working days and pay the filing fee; the VFSC may reject until all consents are documented.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inaugural Board Meeting and Corporate Governance Completion
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company's Board of Directors (administered by registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting (physically or by written resolution with unanimous consent). Adopt the pro-forma First Board Resolution covering share allotment, registered office adoption, and officer appointment. Issue share certificates and open bank accounts after board approval.
required_dossiers: Notice of first board meeting
Minutes of first board meeting or written resolution
Share certificates issued
Corporate bank account application package (with AML/KYC forms)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the onboarding, the board may amend the banking resolution and provide additional corporate or beneficial ownership documents; an alternate bank may be selected.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Ministry of Trade, Industry, Commerce and Tourism – Department of Industry; Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) for investment facilitation and business licence facilitation
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence (issued by the Municipal Council, e.g., Port Vila City Council) and Certificate of Registration as a Medical Device Manufacturing Establishment (issued by the Vanuatu Ministry of Health, if public health import/export of stents is contemplated)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC) – Ministry of Climate Change, Environment, Energy and Water
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration / Category B under the Environment Management and Conservation Act [Cap 283] – for low-impact precision manufacturing with cleanroom operations; supplementary waste management plan required if laser machining produces metallic micro-particles
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: pH 6-9, biochemical oxygen demand (BOD3) ≤ 30 mg/L, total suspended solids ≤ 50 mg/L; exhaust air: volatile organic compounds (VOCs) ≤ 30 mg/m3, particulate matter (PM10) ≤ 150 µg/m3 daily average; hazardous waste must be segregated and transported by an approved carrier to a licensed disposal facility; no ozone-depleting substances permitted in stent cleaning processes

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Police Force Fire Services; structural load inspection and architectural approval from the Port Vila City Council (or Luganville Municipal Council); occupational health and workplace clearance for cleanroom and ISO Class 8 pharmaceutical-grade manufacturing under the Labour (Workers Health and Safety) Act [Cap 136], including sterilisation equipment safety and laser safety protocols

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC) under the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management (portal: vrc.gov.vu); International Company incorporation and registry: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) (portal: vfsc.vu).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: No TIN or VAT ID currently exists. The foreign-owned International Company is incorporated through a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent and receives a unique VFSC company registration number. Obtaining a customs exporter code from VRC requires the certificate of incorporation, registered agent certification, and bank/company details. No further tax registration is required because Vanuatu does not impose income tax, VAT, or withholding tax on qualifying ICs.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election is available under Vanuatu law. The offshore status election is the statutory International Company (IC) form under the International Companies Act; an IC is a non-resident exempt entity that may not conduct local business, hold land, or derive Vanuatu-source income. A domestic company incorporated under the Companies Act is also income tax exempt as Vanuatu has no income tax, but remains subject to municipal business licensing and import/customs charges.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None – Vanuatu has no VAT, GST, or Sales and Use Tax; indirect revenue arises narrowly from customs import duty, tobacco/alcohol excise, environment levy, and municipal licence fees.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: N/A – There is no VAT/GST registration threshold. Draft VAT proposals have not been enacted; until enactment, no threshold applies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing API, digital stamping, or continuous transaction control obligation exists. Electronic customs declarations are lodged through ASYCUDA World for clearance, but that is not a tax e-invoicing mandate.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: No VAT/GST zero-rating is available or necessary because exported goods and offshore services are outside any Vanuatu consumption tax. An IC exporting Class III coronary stents does not require a zero-rating certificate, VAT number, or VAT refund claim. If a future VAT is introduced, zero-rating would require proof of physical export: a customs export declaration, transport documents, and payment evidence, plus registration as a taxable person.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Electronic Export Entry in ASYCUDA World)
Ocean Bill of Lading / Air Waybill
Certificate of Origin (if preferential duty treatment claimed)
VFSC IC Certificate and Registered Agent Declaration
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No export VAT refund currently exists, so no export zero-rating clawback can arise. Misrepresentations and false declarations to VRC/VFSC are penalised: goods may be forfeited, customs fines and imprisonment may be imposed under the Customs Act, and the IC may be deregistered for breaching exempt-status conditions. Any future VAT zero-rating fraud would be subject to retrospective assessment, late payment interest, and statutory penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 125], is the sole central bank, monetary authority and banking supervisor; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) regulates non-bank financial services, including financial dealers and securities, and registers International Companies under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. Commercial banking is licensed by the RBV under the Banking Act [Cap. 42].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates without any exchange control legislation; the Vatu (VUV) is fully convertible across both current and capital accounts. The exchange rate regime is a managed float against an undisclosed trade-weighted basket comprising the USD, AUD, EUR and JPY, with the official mid-rate published daily by RBV. Profit remittance, dividend distribution, royalty and interest payments, and capital repatriation are unrestricted for an International Company under the Tax Exempt Zone classification. The only practical condition is compliance with the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2017 (AML/CTF Act) and the RBV/VFSC customer due diligence rules.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Vanuatu imposes no statutory surrender obligation, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation timeline for export receipts. A Vanuatu IC may retain 100 percent of foreign currency export proceeds in any authorised VUV or foreign currency account. Documentary evidence of the underlying export transaction (commercial invoice, transport document, and customs export declaration) must nonetheless be retained for AML/CTF and bank CDD inspection upon request.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Multi-Currency Account (VUV, USD, AUD, EUR, JPY)
Operational Account (VUV, EUR, USD) with trade finance line
Operational Account and Import/Export LC Facility (VUV and foreign currencies)
Operational VUV Account (retail-oriented; limited cross-border capability)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Vanuatu has no dedicated Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licence category. The Financial Dealers Act [Cap. 70] authorises only non-deposit-taking financial dealers for FX and securities dealing, while the Banking Act [Cap. 42] reserves deposit-taking and payment-clearing functions for licensed banks. Offshore digital EMIs (EU, UK, Singapore) cannot obtain a VUV settlement account, cannot access the RBV wholesale payment system, and may operate only in foreign currency corridors outside the domestic clearing network. A VFSC Financial Dealer licence provides no clearing utility; any EMI wishing to settle in VUV must engage a licensed domestic bank as settlement agent.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In practice, at least one director or authorised signatory must attend a physical identity interview at the bank branch in Port Vila or Santo for the initial account opening, because the Class III MedTech profile triggers enhanced due diligence under the RBV AML/CTF Rules. Remote opening is possible only in narrow cases where the IC already holds a banking relationship with the same institution or with an introducing correspondent bank; such cases require a notarised and apostilled board resolution, certified passport copies, a home-bank bank reference, a live video verification call, and originals delivered by courier within 15 business days. Physical presence is strongly recommended for the executed signatory mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore shell IC with nominee shareholders or trust-based ownership causing beneficial ownership opacity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete chain-of-ownership chart from the IC to each ultimate beneficial owner; beneficial ownership declaration filed with the VFSC; passport copies of all UBOs; registered agent confirmation letter; audited financial statements or certified net-worth statement for each UBO; and an explanation of the group treasury structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk product classification - Class III coronary drug-eluting stent manufacturing triggering sector-based enhanced due diligence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ISO 13485 certificate; EU CE marking (MDR 2017/745) or FDA 510(k)/PMA or TGA clearance; WHO GMP certificate; manufacturing and distribution agreements with the OEM substrate supplier; premises lease and substance documentation; headcount evidence; master supply contracts and pro-forma invoices.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds verification failure for inbound equity capital injection from a related offshore entity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed share subscription agreement; certified board resolution approving the capital increase; six months of bank statements from each remitting shareholder; source-of-wealth statement with supporting asset documentation; updated register of members; and a funds-flow narrative consistent with the IC business plan.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or adverse-media exposure in the medical device supply chain or end-customer geography
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions screening outputs against OFAC, EU and UN consolidated lists for all counterparties; EDD profiles of suppliers and distributors; anti-corruption and export-control compliance attestations; customs declarations and export/import licences; and a transaction flow map documenting each trade payment and delivery step.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Standard compliant routing is a SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's bank to the IC's USD or VUV denominated account at a Port Vila licensed bank, with Field 23B set to CRED and Field 70 stating: Capital injection / share subscription of Vanuatu International Company [name], IC No. [VFSC registration number]. Vanuatu has no exchange control, so no RBV or VFSC prior approval is required, but the receiving bank applies standard CDD and may provisionally restrict withdrawals until the verification pack is delivered. Required verification pack: certified board resolution; signed share subscription agreement; updated register of members; notice of share allotment filed with the VFSC through the registered agent; and identity documentation of the remitting shareholder. Inbound funds in AUD or EUR are converted into VUV or USD at the RBV daily mid-rate plus bank margin.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements use two principal clearing rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 direct wires for open-account settlements and working capital payments, cleared through the bank's correspondent network (USD via New York correspondents such as JPMorgan or Citibank; AUD via ANZ Sydney; EUR via Bred Paris); and (2) documentary letters of credit issued under UCP 600 via SWIFT MT700, with amendments via MT707, for import of bioresorbable polymer substrates and precision tubing, confirmed by a prime bank in the supplier's jurisdiction where needed. Sight and usance tenors are permissible. For controlled MedTech shipments, bank documentary collections under URC 522 with MT400 series messages are also accepted. Every disbursement must reference the underlying invoice, trade contract and ISO 9362 BIC of the counterparty, and must be supported by shipment and customs documentation retained for AML/CTF audit.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forward Outrights in VUV/USD, VUV/AUD, VUV/EUR and VUV/JPY offered by ANZ, BSP and Bred up to 12 months, trade-backed and documented.
Offshore FX Forwards and Cross-Currency Swaps in USD/AUD, EUR/USD and USD/JPY executed with the group treasury or through a VFSC-licensed financial dealer for hedging procurement and sale mismatches.

Natural hedging via multi-currency operational accounts with periodic netting of USD revenues against USD-denominated stent component purchases; no active VUV non-deliverable forward market exists due to the basket peg.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee (Annual Exemption Fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via Licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary date of incorporation; late payment is subject to immediate penalty
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late penalty per month or part thereof; continued non-payment for 6 months may lead to administrative strike-off and dissolution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous requirement; any change of agent or office must be lodged with VFSC within 21 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed registered agent or a registered office is a ground for administrative cancellation after formal notice

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No statutory annual return or accounts filing requirement for a Vanuatu International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No sanction applicable because no annual return is required by the International Companies Act

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit threshold; Vanuatu International Companies are exempt from statutory audit and are not required to file financial statements with VFSC
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed local GAAP; IFRS recommended for voluntary management accounts and external financing; no statutory framework applies

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO confirmation filing is required; the licensed registered agent must maintain current beneficial ownership information and update records on any share transfer or change, with no annual affirmation filing to VFSC

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable by statute; voluntary audit market rate 2,500-5,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax under the Income Tax Act or any other statute; International Companies (ICs) are statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes pursuant to the International Companies Act [Cap 222], s.116.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate. No general CIT exemption application or tax holiday is required because the IC is wholly outside the Vanuatu tax net. No payroll tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty on share transfers, or inheritance tax applies to ICs. The 15% VAT (effective 1 January 2025) applies only to local supplies of goods/services in Vanuatu; export of medical devices, including coronary drug-eluting stents, is zero-rated. ICs deriving income exclusively from outside Vanuatu are not VAT-registrable.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return – International Company (prescribed form issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], s.113A, as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2016). Lodgement and annual government fee payment are effected electronically through the VFSC Online Registry Portal or by the licensed registered agent on behalf of the IC. No corporate income tax return exists under Vanuatu law.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 11 months after the anniversary of incorporation (or re-registration) and annually thereafter, aligned with payment of the VFSC annual levy. The registered agent is obligated to procure lodgement of the Annual Return and the beneficial ownership declaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered name, International Company number, date of incorporation, and current status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide name exactly as registered with VFSC; no notarial translation required for English names.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 – Registered Office and Registered Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Address of the registered office in Vanuatu and identification of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Registered office must physically exist in Vanuatu with the agent; PO Box in Vanuatu alone is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current full particulars of all directors and shareholders, including residential addresses, nationality, and shareholding percentages.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors and shareholders may be listed without a Vanuatu address; a service-of-process address outside Vanuatu is acceptable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of each ultimate beneficial owner (UBO), nature and extent of control, and source of funds (mandatory under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018, as amended).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: UBO data must be held at the registered office and accessible to VFSC and law enforcement; use of nominee shareholders requires full written disclosure of the principal.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Sworn statement that the IC has not carried on business in Vanuatu, holds no real property in Vanuatu, and has no resident directors engaged in domestic trade.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If marketing, warehousing, or sales activity occurs in Vanuatu, this declaration is false and triggers VFSC enforcement; keep clinical-manufacturing activity physically outside Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: A concise balance sheet or statement of assets, liabilities, and capital sufficient to reflect the financial position of the IC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Audit is not mandatory for the IC unless it holds a VFSC financial-services licence; a director-certified summary is acceptable for filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signed declaration of accuracy and compliance with the IC Act, the AML/CFT Act, and the UBO record-keeping requirements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident director may sign, but the registered agent remains statutorily liable for content accuracy under the Companies and Trust Services Providers Act.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late lodgement triggers a VFSC late fee (approximately VUV 20,000 per return plus VUV 10,000 per month or part-month, subject to the current published VFSC fee schedule). Failure for 12 consecutive months exposes the IC to administrative strike-off, asset vesting in the Government of Vanuatu (recoverable only by court restoration), disqualification of the registered agent, and a fine of up to VUV 1,000,000 plus imprisonment of up to 2 years for a knowingly false declaration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return (Form VAT-100) filed electronically through the Vanuatu VAT online portal administered by the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; conditional — required only if the IC makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu (e.g., local stent distribution to Vanuatu hospitals), never for pure offshore export sales.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly; quarterly instalments available for small registered persons meeting the VUV 10,000,000 annual turnover threshold.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the 21st day of the month following the end of the tax period; payment of output VAT net of input credits is due with the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross value of standard-rated supplies made in Vanuatu at 15% VAT, excluding zero-rated exports.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Export of Class III coronary stents to foreign distributors is zero-rated; provide bills of lading, customs declarations, and proof of export from Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of exports and internationally supplied services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retain full shipping documentation and foreign-currency invoices for at least 7 years; zero-rating is denied where goods remain in Vanuatu for local consumption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT paid on eligible business inputs attributable to taxable or zero-rated supplies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs with no Vanuatu establishment cannot claim input credits; claim only on invoices properly issued by Vanuatu VAT registrants.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late return: fixed penalty of VUV 5,000–50,000. Under-declaration: 25% penalty plus 2% monthly interest. Intentional evasion: 200% penalty, seizure of movable property, and imprisonment of up to 2 years; directors may incur secondary liability when the company's non-payment results from recklessness.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu law imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders. There is no income tax act levying WHT, and the IC Act s.116 exempts distributions from all Vanuatu taxation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreements (DTAs) for income taxes and no income tax residency regime. A Vanuatu tax residency certificate is therefore not issuable. Instead, an IC may obtain a VFSC 'Certificate of Good Standing' or a registrar's 'Tax Exemption Certificate' certifying the statutory 0% rate and the absence of a Vanuatu income tax charge; this certificate supports foreign tax credit or participation-exemption claims in the beneficial owner's home jurisdiction. The shareholder must substantiate the exemption claim in the home jurisdiction under applicable CFC, GILTI, PFIC, or ATAD rules, as Vanuatu cannot independently confirm foreign tax status.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate on royalties and 0% statutory rate on debt interest paid by an IC to non-residents. No treaty rates apply because no DTAs exist. Intra-group licensing or lending arrangements should nevertheless be documented with written agreements to prevent recharacterization by the counterparty jurisdiction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold — Vanuatu has no domestic transfer-pricing law, no Local File, no Master File, and no country-by-country reporting obligation under VFSC rules. For practical compliance, an IC that transacts with related parties (stent component procurement, royalty flows, intercompany debt) should prepare voluntary OECD-aligned TP documentation when the annual value of controlled transactions exceeds VUV 20,000,000 (approximately USD 160,000), because such documentation will be demanded by the counterparty tax authority and supports economic substance assertions.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP — Comparable Uncontrolled Price (preferred for commodity-like stent components and distribution margins)
Resale Price Method (suitable for buy-sell distribution of finished stents)
Cost Plus Method (applicable to toll manufacturing and micro-machining services)
Transactional Net Margin Method (TNMM) (most reliably applied where the VU IC acts as a routine distributor or contract manufacturer)
Transactional Profit Split Method (appropriate where IP-bearing stent technology contributes valuable intangibles)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) comparable to BVI or Cayman. However, economic substance is de facto enforced through three channels: (1) the IC Act requires an in-Vanuatu licensed registered agent and registered office and prohibits domestic business activity; (2) the AML/CFT Act requires current UBO records to be physically maintained at the registered office; and (3) VFSC licensing standards require real activity for financial-service licence holders. For a coronary drug-eluting stent manufacturer, substantive functions (laser micro-machining, quality control, distribution contracts, board decisions) should be visibly performed outside Vanuatu, in the beneficial owner's operating jurisdiction, to avoid the VU IC being characterized as a 'managed from abroad' shell by OECD/EU listing criteria and foreign CFC regimes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Corporate Income Tax Evasion / Sham Offshore Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Marketing the Vanuatu IC as 'tax-free' while central management, contract negotiation, treasury functions, and stent IP ownership are effectively exercised in a high-tax jurisdiction; causing the IC to invoice pass-through commissions with no real staff, premises, or commercial risk; making false declarations in the VFSC Annual Return that the IC has no Vanuatu business presence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: In Vanuatu, no income tax can be assessed, but a knowingly false Annual Return is an offence under the IC Act punishable by a fine of up to VUV 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 2 years; VFSC may strike off the IC and prohibit the registered agent from acting. In the beneficial owner's home jurisdiction, invocation of CFC/ATAD/GILTI rules produces back taxes, interest, and accuracy-related penalties commonly exceeding 100% of the tax understatement; criminal tax evasion charges may follow where foreign returns falsely claim a Vanuatu 0% rate without substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil restitution of unpaid foreign taxes under shadow-director theories; travel bans and border alerts under mutual assistance treaty requests; extradition risk for tax-evasion indictments; in Vanuatu, individual directors who sign false declarations face personal fines, imprisonment, and disqualification from acting as directors of any VFSC-regulated company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining only a registered agent letterbox with no board meetings, no minutes, no management decisions, no bank account in the IC's own name, and no documented commercial rationale; using the IC as an invoice pass-through for stent sales within an OECD multinational group; failing to distinguish the IC's assets from the founder's personal accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC administrative strike-off of the IC after persistent non-compliance; upon strike-off, assets vest in the Government of Vanuatu and require court restoration at significant cost (VUV 100,000+ plus legal fees); third-party creditors may pierce the exemption; the entity may be placed on EU/OECD non-cooperative lists, disrupting SWIFT wire and letter-of-credit processing by correspondent banks.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors jointly and severally liable for restoration costs and for claims by creditors who transacted under a misleadingly opaque structure; disqualification orders issued by VFSC; personal exposure in the home jurisdiction under controlled-foreign-corporation attribution, causing the shareholder's worldwide stent-manufacturing income to be taxed currently at full marginal rates.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breach and Beneficial Ownership Non-Disclosure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file or update the UBO declaration; use of bearer shares (prohibited since the 2016 amendment); nominee arrangements concealing the true owner of the stent-manufacturing business; accepting third-party funds without customer due diligence; failing to report suspicious transactions relating to the letter-of-credit or SWIFT rail payments; transacting with sanctioned persons without screening.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018 (as amended), civil penalties of up to VUV 50,000,000 per contravention; criminal money-laundering offences expose the IC to unlimited fines and forfeiture of the value of the proceeds (including all stent-export revenue) plus imprisonment of the responsible individuals for up to 15 years; VFSC may suspend or revoke the IC's registration and the registered agent's licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Direct criminal liability of directors and compliance officers for money laundering; asset freezes and restraint orders under mutual-assistance requests; statutory offence of 'tipping off' a client about a suspicious-transaction report resulting in 2 years' imprisonment; travel bans and post-conviction confiscation of personal residences; director disqualification for financial-crime conduct.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: VAT Evasion and Local Medical-Distribution Mischaracterization
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Physically importing or selling coronary drug-eluting stents to hospitals, clinics, or distributors inside Vanuatu without registering for the 15% VAT; falsely zero-rating goods that are in fact consumed in Vanuatu; invoicing local sales through the offshore IC to avoid VAT; claiming input-credit refunds on intra-group services with no real Vanuatu establishment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the VAT Act 2024 (effective 1 January 2025): penalty of 100% of the evaded VAT plus 2% monthly interest; seizure and disposal of the stent inventory present in Vanuatu; a fine of up to VUV 20,000,000 for directors who knowingly cause evasion; imprisonment of up to 2 years; cancellation of the IC's right to conduct any local supply activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for the IC's VAT debt where the failure is attributable to their recklessness or wilful blindness; personal liability extends to civil recovery orders and disqualification from managing any Vanuatu business; non-resident directors may be arrested upon entering Vanuatu under warrant for VAT-fraud prosecution.
